event.market.call.1: Fresh bread and pumpkin pie! Get it while it lasts!
event.market.call.2: Come closer, market day in %2$s is only today!
event.market.call.3: Good prices, good wares and better company!

event.market.greet.1: Morning, %1$s! Have a look, looking is free.
event.market.greet.2: Welcome to the market of %2$s. The best of the land, right here.
event.market.greet.3: Looking for something? If I haven't got it, my neighbour has.

event.market.guest.1: I come every week and I always buy something I don't need.
event.market.guest.2: They say today's fish comes from far away. I don't believe it.
event.market.guest.3: Out of my way, I'm late for the cake.

event.wedding.ceremony.1: Dear neighbours of %2$s: we are gathered here to join these two young people.
event.wedding.ceremony.2: May they share their bread, their roof and their sorrows, and may the sorrows be few.
event.wedding.ceremony.3: With the bell as our witness, I now pronounce you husband and wife!

event.wedding.greet.2: Come in, come in. Today nobody is a stranger in %2$s.
event.wedding.greet.3: We're getting married, can you believe it? I still can't.

event.wedding.thanks.3: Thank you, truly. Stay for the party, there's cake.

event.wedding.ask.1: Thank you for coming. Did you bring something for the couple?
event.wedding.ask.2: Here it's the custom to bring flowers, even just one.
event.wedding.ask.3: So glad you're here! You know, a little gift never goes amiss.

event.wedding.guest.1: I always knew they'd end up together. The whole village knew.
event.wedding.guest.2: Doesn't the bride look lovely! And him... well, him too.
event.wedding.guest.3: I skipped breakfast to make room for the cake.

event.funeral.eulogy.1: Today we say farewell to one of our own, a neighbour of %2$s all his life.
event.funeral.eulogy.2: He worked the land, shared his table and never closed his door.
event.funeral.eulogy.3: May he rest in peace. His memory stays in %2$s.

event.funeral.greet.1: Thank you for being with us, %1$s.
event.funeral.greet.2: He was a good man. All of %2$s knows it.
event.funeral.greet.3: Stay with us a moment, if you can.

event.funeral.thanks.1: Thank you, %1$s. He would have liked that.
event.funeral.thanks.3: Thank you. Lay it beside him, please.

event.funeral.ask.1: It's the custom here to leave a flower. If you have one...
event.funeral.ask.2: Thank you for coming. He always welcomed strangers.
event.funeral.ask.3: There's no need for anything. But a candle would light his way.

event.funeral.guest.1: He taught me to milk a cow when I was a boy.
event.funeral.guest.2: He always said the bell rang far too early.
event.funeral.guest.3: How quiet the square is today.

event.festival.call.1: Come on, everybody dance, the night is young!
event.festival.call.2: Cookies, cake and fireworks! The festival of %2$s is the best for miles!
event.festival.call.3: One more round for the band!

event.festival.greet.1: %1$s! You're just in time for the dance.
event.festival.greet.2: Welcome to the festival of %2$s. Eat, drink and dance.
event.festival.greet.3: Will you dance? If you can't, nobody here can either.

event.festival.song.1: Another one? This one's for you, %1$s!
event.festival.song.2: We used to play this one as children in %2$s. Let's see if I remember it!
event.festival.song.3: Ask for whatever you like, there's no charge today.

event.festival.guest.1: Don't stop, don't stop, my hat's falling off!
event.festival.guest.2: Last year I danced until sunrise. This year too.
event.festival.guest.3: My grandmother dances better than I do, and she's ninety.
